candidate_identity.required_artifacts: Fresh static GNU Linux worker and matching Windows GUI with byte-verified embedding. No protocol2 helper, PE worker or Linux GUI is required for this primary experiment.

acceptance.execution: Six serial fresh processes through one owned private mux/CDP tunnel; exact PID/create-time cleanup, free ports and native fixture/raw guards before and after. No concurrent builds or profiling.
acceptance.goal: Every cross-cell opening/action p95 below250ms, representative first/cold behavior and exact delivered builds; full campaign remains incomplete.
acceptance.hypothesis: Actual Linux execution uses the existing Git CLI branch-summary path to reduce measured first-comparison CPU; Windows native comparison, GUI code and existing helper placement remain unchanged.
acceptance.ipc_diagnostic: Keep foreground intervals, overlapping background refresh, pending IPC and remainder. Backend evidence is not a GUI latency score.
acceptance.measurement: Unchanged canonical Open plus six actions, native Git/content/comment checks and two animation frames. Default renderer, same seeded profile and MCP. Completed welcome startup async error precedes measured Open. No helper preseed, cache flush or new tracing.
pilot_acceptance: Every launch, native correctness, scoring, fixture, identity and cleanup gate passes. An invalid run stops the series; no measurement retry within it.
Worst p95 across Open and all six actions improves by at least10% against the new interleaved A series.

At least one of fresh-process Open median or maximum p95 across branch_first, branch_final, stack and comment_branch improves by at least10%; an A1-only first-use drop does not establish a candidate gain.
Every final20 action p95 and maximum, plus fresh-process Open median, p95 and maximum, remains at most110% of matching new A. Keep every first-use sample and investigate failed guards.
Noisy or below-threshold evidence is inconclusive. This one-cell experiment cannot promote or complete the full four-cell and cold-cache campaign.
acceptance.preserved_controls: Same profile, repository, branch stack, comments, manifest, source/binary identities and two completion frames. No mixed helper-placement or staged-metadata candidate.
acceptance.primary_metric: Worst end-to-end p95 across fresh-process Open and all six actions; report all opening and action first-use values separately. Fresh process is not OS-cold.
acceptance.producer_gate: Require exact-root manifest Cargo compiler-artifact records for optimized GNU worker, its unit and stdio tests, and fresh Windows GUI bin/lib. Root artifacts must have fresh:false, exact target names/kinds/test flags, and reported executable paths/filenames within the owned release caches; do not assume a Cargo test deps layout. Packaged mode is proved by actual tauri and tauri_macros dependency custom-protocol features and production build-script cfgs, independently of root feature[]. Copied worker/GUI producer links, real25+1 test names, kernel parity, source provenance and raw fixture guards remain strict. The original failed R2 assertion record remains unchanged and is paired with a hashed no-rebuild recovery report. Canonical live-app readiness and content/comment correctness still gate every timing sample.
acceptance.runtime_release: VM LINUX CLI BRANCH RUNTIME RELEASED

baseline_identity_note: Both sources are pinned to b2. Candidate changes only the Linux execution branch-summary path; Windows native policy and helper placement are unchanged.
caller_transport: One task-owned private ControlMaster/CDP forward; all child SSH calls select it and refuse new TCP fallback.
measurement: Canonical Open and all six actions; completed welcome startup error; no warmup or cache flush.
profiles: Reuse the existing two-comment profiles directly; no copies, seeding or helper preparation.
retained_previous_attempt: Historical status, staged-metadata and helper results remain separate; no old samples are pooled.
